Name: Nessus Scan Information
Synopsis: This plugin displays information about the Nessus scan.

Name: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Synopsis: The remote host runs a version of Log4j affected by an RCE.

Name: Spring Framework RCE (Spring4Shell)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by the Spring4Shell RCE vulnerability.
Solution: Upgrade Spring Framework to a fixed version.

Name: SSL Certificate Cannot Be Trusted
Synopsis: The SSL certificate for this service cannot be trusted.
Solution: Purchase or generate a proper certificate.

Name: MS17-010 EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by the EternalBlue SMBv1 vulnerability.

Name: MS RDP Remote Code Execution (BlueKeep)
Synopsis: The remote host is affected by the BlueKeep RDP RCE vulnerability.
Solution: Apply the Microsoft security update for CVE-2019-0708.

Name: SSL Certificate Signed Using Weak Hashing (MD5)
Synopsis: The SSL certificate uses a weak signature algorithm.
Solution: Reissue the certificate using SHA-256 or stronger.
